provenance.basis: R15 and Falda1667: Trinita/Sistina, Barberini, QuattroFontane, and Maggiore corridor read on the original. Native local two-anchor registration per leg; widths and undated micro-alignment estimated. Not a straight church-to-church invented route; SantaCroce continuation not reconstructed.
